values.note: Electric sites $36 a night ($252 a week) in both loops. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass ($10-$15) or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/north-sterling-state-park/north-sterling-state-park-camping-lodging ('Single campsite (max 6 occupants)' $36; 'Daily Vehicle Pass: $10-$15') + cpwshop.com site pages, all 89 sites ('$36.00 /Per Night $252.00 /Per Week', arrival 06/16/2027), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: cpwshop.com site pages, all 46 Inlet Grove and 43 Chimney View sites (Site Type 'Electric', 'Electricity Hookup: 50'; no water or sewer hookup listed; CPW sells water and full-hookup sites as separate types) + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/north-sterling-state-park/north-sterling-state-park-camping-lodging ('50 amps hook ups'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Inlet Grove 46 sites (095-140): 43 pull-throughs for 74-98 ft plus back-ins 114 (48 ft), 115 (55) and 116 (58). Chimney View 43 sites (051-094), all pull-throughs, 74-100 ft. Six people a site.

sites.source: cpwshop.com site pages, all 89 sites ('Maximum Vehicle Length', 'Driveway Entry'), arrival 06/16/2027 + CPW camping page ('A maximum of six people are allowed per campsite'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Camper services building with flush toilets, showers and coin laundry in season. Water is winterized October-April; winter campers have a vault restroom in the middle of Chimney View.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/north-sterling-state-park/north-sterling-state-park-camping-lodging (Campsite Amenities: 'Camper services building with flush toilets', 'Coin-operated laundry', 'Showers'; Staying During Winter: 'water systems are winterized from October to April ... a vault restroom is located in the middle of the Chimney View campground'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Chimney View is open year-round (vault toilet only, water off October-April). Inlet Grove closes for the winter; CPW publishes no dates (closed as of 2026-10-28).

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/north-sterling-state-park/north-sterling-state-park-camping-lodging ('The Chimney View campground is open year-round, but water systems are winterized from October to April'; Seasonal Closures: 'Inlet Campground: CLOSED', 'Chimney View Campground: OPEN') + cpwshop.com park page ('Open year round.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com (North Sterling State Park listing, loop Inlet Grove or Chimney View) or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead. 14 days within a 28-day period. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass. An unoccupied first night is a no-show unless you call the park.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/north-sterling-state-park/north-sterling-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at North Sterling State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613 ... up to six months in advance'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period') + cpwshop.com park page (no-show policy), read 2026-10-28

note: Two adjacent loops off the South Entrance road at the inlet cove of North Sterling Reservoir: Inlet Grove (lakeside, large pull-throughs) and Chimney View (added 2013, on a rise, set back). Inlet Grove's water-facing row (sites 116-127) overlooks the inlet cove from an elevated bench; not on a beach apron. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop (all 89 site pages): confirmed $36, 50 A, 89 sites, pull-throughs, reservable on cpwshop. Added water/sewer false, max 100 ft, flush toilets/showers/laundry, season (Chimney View year-round; Inlet Grove closes for winter), fcfs never, 6-month window, 14-in-28 limit. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: SPLIT QUESTION (asks.md, not split): Inlet Grove = 46 sites (095-140), all 50 A electric, $36, max 98 ft (43 pull-through 74-98 ft, back-ins 48/55/58 ft); Chimney View = 43 sites (051-094), all 50 A electric, $36, all pull-through, max 100 ft. Entrance: one shared South Entrance road; on imagery each loop has its own spur road branching off it at the same junction by the entrance station/camper services, Chimney View to the northwest, Inlet Grove to the southwest. Loop centroids (from cpwshop's per-site GIS points): Inlet Grove 40.76488,-103.27492, Chimney View 40.76721,-103.27454 - about 260 m apart, so they do not meet the ~1 km separate-place rule. Waterfront: cpwshop tags 8 Inlet Grove sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (116, 117, 119, 121, 123, 125, 126, 127, the west end facing the inlet cove) and no Chimney View site; on imagery Chimney View sits on the rise ~250 m+ back from the cove behind Inlet Grove. The separate Elks loop (48 sites) is entry 2244, ~2.8 km north.

Waterfront re-audit lead (not changed): stored lakeview vs cpwshop's 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' on Inlet Grove sites 116-127. On current Esri imagery the reservoir is drawn down and the inlet cove west of those sites is exposed, vegetated lake bed; open water is well over 100 m away. The operator's claim differs from ours, so it triggers the gate.
Pin 40.7654,-103.273 sits on the open ground between the two loops, ~170 m from the Inlet Grove centroid and ~200 m from Chimney View's; OK for a two-loop entry.
Status: CPW 'Elks and Inlet Campgrounds are CLOSED for the season. Chimney View Campground is open.' Ordinary seasonal closing, not a status.
Name: CPW's page calls the loop 'Inlet Campground'; cpwshop 'Inlet Grove'. Fine.
